fusions.name: Drawn Tight
fusions.desc: Casts a wide mesh ahead of you that deals 9 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds, and your afflictions on a target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dragnet Haul
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted line into the first enemy it meets, dealing 5 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Snare Set
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 40 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles set it off: it deals 20 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Mesh Advantage
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against any enemy carrying a condition.
